<!-- pr-reviewer: 9da6a7c224309f4207da8919749c7e9c21d2b8f2 -->
**Not built - needs a maintainer look** (new dependencies; merge conflict in code)

Thanks for the logging slice. The seams are the ones #163 names.

**What looks good**
- Events sit at the named seams: save/open (`project/wire.rs` save/load), post (`posting.rs` `post_script`), generation (`operation/generate.rs` + `run_job`), command dispatch (`commands/mod.rs` `History::execute`/`undo`).
- Save, open, generation and post run only from user commands or scripts, not per frame, so there is no per-frame spam.
- Errors are propagated or logged, not unwrapped; `command_name` uses `unwrap_or`. No new `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` outside tests.
- `tracing` evaluates field values only when the level is enabled, so the `debug!` line in `History::execute` costs one interest check per command when debug is off.
- No secrets are logged. Blocked-post and refused-generation reasons are logged with their text.

**Requested before merge**
1. Merge conflict with main in code: `crates/app/src/commands/mod.rs:91-92`. main added the `saved` depth reset to `History::execute`; the PR adds `tracing::debug!(command = command_name(&command), "execute");` in the same place. Please merge `origin/main` into the branch and keep both (not a force-push). The trial merge also touches `RECOMMENDED.md` (ledger, keep both sides).
2. New dependencies (`tracing`, `tracing-subscriber`): `Cargo.toml`, `crates/app/Cargo.toml`, `Cargo.lock`. Per the review rules the build is held for a maintainer look at those files first, so this review is **not built**. I started a build before applying that rule, stopped it, and do not rely on anything from it.
3. Numeric casts: `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:39`, `:45` and `crates/app/src/posting.rs:277` use `as_millis() as u64`. The house rule is safe numeric conversion; use `u64::try_from(started.elapsed().as_millis()).unwrap_or(u64::MAX)` (or a saturating helper) at each.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
- The save/open/NC-write lines log absolute paths of the user's project and output files. They go only to the launching terminal, which is fine for a local app, but a pasted log in a bug report exposes folder layout. Consider file names only, or say so in the docs.
- No timing was measured on the hot paths; by design they are not hot.

**Local results**
- Trial merge with `origin/main`: conflict in `crates/app/src/commands/mod.rs` (code) and `RECOMMENDED.md` (ledger). Per the review rules the PR head was reviewed without merging.
- Build: not built (dependency rule, see item 2).
- Tests and clippy: not run for this head.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 9f7924bab1368c81a5eace58203ed30ab9a6d9dc -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge**

Thanks, bherbruck - the review fixes landed cleanly.

**What looks good**
- Dependencies (Cargo.toml, crates/app/Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock): `tracing` 0.1 and `tracing-subscriber` 0.3 (default features off: fmt, env-filter, ansi, std, tracing-log), workspace-pinned. The lock adds only registry crates (matchers, nu-ansi-term, sharded-slab, thread_local, tracing-log, tracing-subscriber, valuable); no git or path deps, no build.rs, scripts or workflow changes in the diff. All MIT, notice kept in `assets/ui/LICENSES.md`.
- Subscriber init only in the three binaries (`camcraft-cli.rs`, `ui/src/main.rs`); `logging::init` tolerates a second call.
- No unwrap/expect/panic in the new code; `logging::elapsed_ms` saturates via `try_from`; invalid filter env falls back to the default.
- Logs name files only (`logging::file_name`), not folders; events fire per save/open/post/generation, with command dispatch at debug only, so no per-frame spam. No secrets logged.
- `History::execute` keeps both the `saved` reset and the debug event after the main merge; `logging.rs` is 55 lines with provenance; decision file is `docs/decisions/163-tracing.md`, no CHANGELOG edit.

**Local results (merged with origin/main, clean auto-merge)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test` logging / commands_undo / dirty_flag / posting / project_roundtrip / fanuc_post / scripting | 3 / 32 / 2 / 17 / 68 / 8 / 17 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo check -p camcraft-ui --bin camcraft-ui` | ok |

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Body says `Refs #163`, though the task text says Fixes; fine for a first slice - the issue stays open for the remaining println conversion.
- `generate.rs`, `posting.rs` and `wire.rs` were not re-measured against the 400-line guideline beyond this small growth.
- Feat: merges at the next cut.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
